senses.en_definition: Caused by; occurring as a result of something.

messages.en: Where are you now? I'm already at the café.
Sorry, the bus was delayed because of the heavy rain. I've got off the bus and I'm walking to the café now. Give me a minute, okay?
Okay, I'll wait inside. Watch your step—the ground outside the café is slippery.

senses.en_definition: Here; in this place. The standard Malay spelling is di sini.

messages.en: I'm outside the café now. Just wait here, right?
Yep, just wait there. I'm walking over from the car park now.

senses.en_definition: A person qualified and licensed to practise medicine; a medical doctor.
A person who holds a doctoral degree; the title used by such a person.

messages.en: Did you see a doctor earlier? You didn't look too well this morning.
Yeah, I've just got back from the clinic. Thanks for checking on me. I'm taking tomorrow off to rest.

senses.en_definition: The dollar, a unit of currency used in countries including the United States, Singapore, Brunei, Canada and Australia.

messages.en: The tops here are only twenty Singapore dollars. Want me to get you one?
Yes! Do they have blue? If they've got a medium, get me one.
They do. I'll send you a photo first so you can see the colour.
